messages:
sam: FYI - saw a puzzling p99-only bump on /v1/stream in ap-southeast around 07:14. p50/p95 fine.
harper: can you share the endpoint-breakdown? is it tied to a specific route/variant?
sam: route=cheap-quantized shows most of the p99 delta; counts for that route were low (~6-12 reqs/min) during the spike.
tia: did anyone touch routing weights or introduce a new proxy layer? I deployed small routing policy tweak at 06:50 but it targeted different model variants.
analytics: quick check: p99 jumped from ~90ms to ~1.6s for cheap-quantized; p95 stayed ~110ms. sample count for those p99 buckets is small.
harper: small counts + retries often look like this. Are retries marked consistently?
sam: some traces missing request_id or is_retry flag when passing through the experiment proxy. suspect header passthrough bug.
devops-bot: deploybot: routing-policy-change r-2026-03-17-0650 deployed from CI at 2026-03-17T06:50Z.
tia: that deploy didn't touch the experiment proxy but the canary for cheap-quantized started at 07:00 with 25% weight (short window).
analytics: I ran a dedupe by request_id for that minute window: deduped p99 for cheap-quantized drops to ~120ms. indicates retry amplification.
harper: actionable: (1) add request_id propagation check to canary smoke tests, (2) mark low-sample p99s in Console with a tooltip explaining instability, (3) tighten canary warmup when enabling new proxies.
sam: filing tickets: INF-3210 (propagate request_id/is_retry through experiment proxy), MON-5020 (console low-sample hint on p99) and RUN-7601 (canary warmup policy update).
tia: i'll rollback the cheap-quantized canary to 5% and extend warmup to 15m. devops-bot, schedule rollback now.
devops-bot: deploybot: reducing canary weight cheap-quantized -> 5% initiated.
devops-bot: deploybot: canary update complete.
analytics: post-change: p99 back near baseline.
harper: long-term: ingest pipeline should dedupe repeated request_ids within a short window to avoid double-counting retried attempts. also console should show a provenance badge when p99 driven by retries.
sam: agreed. will add example traces to INF-3210 and link MON-5020. leaving thread open until tickets are triaged.
tia: thanks all, will follow up after we validate the 5% warmup run.
sam: :thumbsup: keep an eye on adjacent regions too in case routing fanout causes cross-region retry storms.
